provenance: Recorded research example: independent V_Expression CC BY 4.0, RAVDESS CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and Cilia Figshare CC BY 4.0 development fixtures. Real frozen inference from cached training-schema inputs; not live capture, not held-out evaluation, not aligned participants. Questionnaire answers synthetic. See MODEL_TRAINING_PROTOCOL and MULTIMODAL_TRAINING_REPORT for source versions, licences, preprocessing and hashes.

questionnaire.threshold_source: ARC AQ-10 form (2012), referral cutoff 6 or above; accessed 2026-11-02
questionnaire.notice: This is a threshold-based screening score. The machine-learning model shown beside it was trained on labels using the legacy dataset threshold (7, not the instrument cutoff 6), so it models that legacy rule; it is not an independently validated probability and does not change the result. A screening score is not a diagnosis.

screening_conclusion: Synthetic questionnaire answers only; these separate research examples do not describe one person.
summary: No raw participant media or identifying metadata is included. Speech uses a source 4-second model chunk, not the live 5-second acoustic-quality workflow. Facial input uses the cached detector-processed face; original detection was verified in the training audit.
